name: rtc-transcriber
description: 实时语音转文字工具：本地 SenseVoice 引擎（完全离线）/ 阿里云百炼 ASR / 浏览器 Web Speech，支持网页与 Tauri 桌面端。

scripts.build: npm test && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/css dist/js && cp src/index.html dist/index.html && cp -R src/css/. dist/css/ && cp -R src/js/. dist/js/ && cd meeting-board && npm install && npx vite build
scripts.test: node scripts/check-static.mjs && node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON tests/main-status.test.mjs && node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON tests/tray-status.test.mjs && node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON tests/tray-speaking.test.mjs && node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON tests/model-recovery.test.mjs && node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON tests/audio-recovery.test.mjs && node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON tests/app-rule-lists.test.mjs && node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON tests/vad.test.mjs && node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON tests/time-grouping.test.mjs
